notes: Nineteen ranks, ordered low to high, matching the owner's stated Samurai ladder size. Privileges are the mechanical hooks; only the tiers assigned to a unit in units.json are exercised in battle today. Tiers with an empty privileges object are real rungs on the ladder reserved for units not yet rostered.

ranks.title: Umamawari
ranks.description: Third-rank retainer. Right to wear two swords.

ranks.title: Churo
ranks.description: Second-rank retainer. Two swords; rides to war.

ranks.title: Koshogumi (first-rank retainer)
ranks.description: First-rank retainer. Two swords; always mounted.

ranks.title: Hatamoto
ranks.description: Banner Knight. Carries the lord's banner in the field.

ranks.title: Jun-kokushu (Tozama) Daimyo
ranks.description: Outer lord ranked alongside provincial lords.

ranks.title: Kunimochi-nami (Fudai) Daimyo
ranks.description: Hereditary lord treated as a province holder.

privilegeRules.twoSwords: +50 ATK on reaction attacks (zone-of-control strikes and Overwatch).
privilegeRules.mounted: 'war' grants +1 Movement while any enemy is within 6 hexes; 'always' grants +1 Movement unconditionally.
privilegeRules.commandRadiusBonus: Added to the unit's command radius for aura reach and morale recovery.
privilegeRules.banner: Platoon members inside the leader's command radius recover +5 additional Morale in the Command Phase.
privilegeRules.castle: Allies inside the leader's command radius standing on a Fortification hex gain a further +100 DEF.
